B=((np.arange(512)[:,None] >> np.arange(9)) & 1)
ages=np.arange(18.5,90,1)
labs=np.arange(.125,10,.25)
X=np.zeros((len(labs)*512,11));X[:,1:10]=np.tile(B,(len(labs),1));X[:,10]=np.repeat(labs,512)
Y=np.zeros((len(ages),len(labs),512))
for k,age in enumerate(ages):
 X[:,0]=(age-60)/10
 Y[k]=predict(X).reshape(len(labs),512)
def residual(Y,B):
 g=Y.mean()
 R=Y-(Y.mean(axis=(1,2))-g)[:,None,None]-(Y.mean(axis=(0,2))-g)[None,:,None]-g
 for j in range(9):
  for v in [0,1]:
   mask=B[:,j]==v
   R[:,:,mask]-=Y[:,:,mask].mean()-g
 return R
R=residual(Y,B)
print('additive variance explained',1-np.var(R)/np.var(Y),'RMS',np.std(R))
bm=(B[:,1]==1)&(B[:,6]==0)
r=R[ages>75][:,labs>4][:,:,bm]
print('older>75,wfns1,surgery0,lab>4','mean',r.mean(),'SD',r.std(),'quantiles',np.quantile(r,[0,.05,.25,.5,.75,.95,1]),'fraction negative',(r<0).mean())
bm2=(B[:,1]==0)&(B[:,6]==1)
r=R[ages<=30][:,:,bm2]

print('young<=30,wfns0,surgery1,l7>4',R[ages<=30][:,labs>4][:,:,bm2].mean())
print('rural farmer conservative residual',R[:,:,(B[:,7]==0)&(B[:,8]==1)&(B[:,6]==0)].mean())
print('old wfns severe conservative all labs',R[ages>75][:,:,bm].mean())
print('old wfns severe conservative lab<=4',R[ages>75][:,labs<=4][:,:,bm].mean())
for amin,amax in [(18,90),(30,90),(40,90),(18,85),(18,95)]:
 amask=(ages>=amin)&(ages<amax)
 R2=residual(Y[amask],B)
 print('reference',amin,amax,'older group mean',R2[ages[amask]>75][:,labs>4][:,:,bm].mean())
